label: new
details: Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) – Open-world action-adventure game by Rockstar Games, set in Vice City, featuring Jason and Lucia.
Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare – First-person military shooter by Infinity Ward, featuring intense combat and a modern warfare storyline.
Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice – Action-adventure game by FromSoftware, featuring challenging sword combat, stealth, and a samurai-inspired world.
Beast of Reincarnation – Action RPG by Game Freak, featuring a post-apocalyptic world, intense combat, exploration, and a unique human-and-dog partnership.
Red Dead Redemption 2 (RDR2) – Open-world action-adventure game by Rockstar Games, featuring an immersive Wild West setting, outlaw life, exploration, and a gripping story.
Marvel's Wolverine – Action-adventure game by Insomniac Games, featuring intense combat, brutal claws, and an immersive story based on the Marvel superhero Wolverine.

label: new
details: Phantom Blade Zero – Action RPG by S-GAME, featuring fast-paced martial arts combat, stylish sword fighting, and a dark fantasy world inspired by Chinese culture.
God of War Ragnarök – Kratos and Atreus journey through the Nine Realms as Fimbulwinter grips the world and Ragnarök draws near, with brutal Norse-mythology combat.
Marvel's Spider-Man 2 – Play as Peter Parker and Miles Morales, swing across an expanded New York, and face Venom and Kraven in a story-driven superhero adventure.
Horizon Forbidden West – Aloy travels to the dangerous western frontier of a post-apocalyptic America to uncover the source of a deadly plague, hunting huge machines along the way.
The Last of Us Part I – A full remake of the acclaimed story following Joel and Ellie across a ruined United States, with rebuilt visuals and gameplay.
Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut – Play as samurai Jin Sakai defending Tsushima Island from the Mongol invasion, including the Iki Island expansion.
Elden Ring – A vast open-world action RPG by FromSoftware and George R. R. Martin, set in the Lands Between with punishing combat and deep exploration.
Demon's Souls – A ground-up remake of the classic dark fantasy RPG, set in the cursed kingdom of Boletaria with demanding combat and stunning PS5 visuals.
Returnal – A third-person roguelike shooter where Selene is trapped in a time loop on an alien planet, dying and restarting with fast, intense combat.
Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart – Jump between dimensions with Ratchet and Rivet in a colourful, gadget-filled platformer that showcases the PS5's speed.
Final Fantasy VII Rebirth – Cloud and his companions leave Midgar and explore a vast open world in the second chapter of the Remake trilogy.
Astro Bot – A joyful 3D platformer packed with inventive levels and PlayStation cameos, using the DualSense controller in clever ways.
Black Myth: Wukong – An action RPG inspired by Journey to the West, with fast staff combat, transformations, and huge mythological bosses.
Cyberpunk 2077 – A first-person open-world RPG set in Night City, where you play as the mercenary V chasing a unique implant that grants immortality.
Resident Evil 4 – A modern remake of the survival horror classic, following Leon S. Kennedy as he rescues the president's daughter from a sinister village cult.
Hogwarts Legacy – An open-world action RPG set in the 1800s wizarding world, where you attend Hogwarts, learn spells, and uncover an ancient secret.
Baldur's Gate 3 – A deep, choice-driven Dungeons & Dragons RPG with turn-based combat, memorable companions, and branching storylines.
Death Stranding Director's Cut – Hideo Kojima's strange, atmospheric journey as Sam Porter Bridges reconnects a shattered America, with added PS5 content.
Stellar Blade – A stylish sci-fi action game where Eve fights to reclaim Earth from the Naytiba, with fast, parry-focused blade combat.
Silent Hill 2 – A remake of the psychological horror classic, following James Sunderland into the fog-covered town after receiving a letter from his late wife.
Assassin's Creed Shadows – Set in feudal Japan, play as the shinobi Naoe and the samurai Yasuke in a sprawling open-world stealth and action adventure.
